lines.text: Rezin king of Aram and Pekah king of Israel marched against Jerusalem but could not overpower it.
The LORD sent Isaiah and Shear-jashub to meet Ahaz, because Aram and Ephraim planned to crown the son of Tabeal.
The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is the son of Jotham.
The LORD told Ahaz to ask for a sign, but he refused, so the Lord Himself would give one.
The LORD would whistle to the flies at the Nile and use a razor hired from beyond the Jordan.
